threads.body: [Javaagent] Replacing these entries changes the registrations exposed by MCP 2.1's `asyncHttpRequestCustomizers(...)` API. After the first `build()`, `list.remove(originalCustomizer)` no longer finds the registered instance, so a rebuilt transport still invokes the customizer the application tried to remove. Leave the builder's registration list unchanged and wrap the composed customizer used by the transport instead; add an installed-agent regression covering build, removal, and rebuild.
